subject: Post-demo: validate commit slab and procurement cutoffs for Q3 pilot
messages:
From: Aisha Rao <aisha.rao@fieldstonehealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: raj.patel@fieldstonehealth.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up after demo — spend band and PO thresholds

Hi Soojin / Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the cost controls you showed. Finance and procurement asked for two quick pieces to validate feasibility before we take this to legal: 1) a realistic monthly spend band (low / mid / high) for a 3-month pilot based on 1M–5M monthly inference tokens and the unit econ assumptions you use, and 2) the procurement cutoffs (PO thresholds / lead times) that would apply for a pilot commit.

We attached a brief procurement checklist for context (procurement@ included) and our preferred PO cadence. Can you send a short table (or updated worksheet) with $/1M token targets for each slab and an indication of whether a PO is required for < $25k / $25–75k / > $75k?

Goal: align on numbers today so I can get a preliminary OK from finance tomorrow.

Thanks,
Aisha
Procurement Lead, Fieldstone Health
[attachment: procurement_requirements.pdf]

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Aisha Rao <aisha.rao@fieldstonehealth.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 12:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up after demo — spend band and PO thresholds

Aisha — thanks for the clear ask.

Short answer up front: we can model a 3-slab monthly corridor and map PO requirements to Fieldstone's thresholds. Attached is a populated workbook (Fieldstone_pricing_model_v2.xlsx) and a one-page draft MAP that outlines milestones and billing cadence. Key highlights: 

- Slab pricing (approx; final depends on exact token mix):
  • Low (1M tokens/mo): $1,600 per 1M tokens
  • Mid (3M tokens/mo): $1,150 per 1M tokens (effective rate)
  • High (5M tokens/mo): $920 per 1M tokens (volume step-down + cache savings)

- Procurement cutoffs:
  • < $25k/month — no PO required for pilot; standard SOW + invoice is OK (finance suggested).
  • $25k–$75k/month — PO recommended; 2–3 week lead time for onboarding and account provisioning.
  • > $75k/month — PO required; 4+ week lead time and we recommend a short reserved capacity add-on (dedicated pool) to guarantee latency.

- Unit econ assumptions in worksheet: average prompt length 120 tokens, generation 350 tokens, 40% prefix caching effectiveness on repeated prompts, and batching producing 8–15% token-cost savings at mid/high volumes. See tab "assumptions" in the workbook.

Next steps I propose: Jordan to review the workbook and surface any internal discounts; Vivek to confirm SLA and reserved capacity options if you intend to move >75k. If that looks good, we can get a draft PO template to you by Monday.

Attached:
- Fieldstone_pricing_model_v2.xlsx
- Draft-MAP-Fieldstone.pdf

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415 555 0192

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: Aisha Rao <aisha.rao@fieldstonehealth.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up after demo — spend band and PO thresholds

Aisha — quick note from finance side: the $/1M figures Soojin sent are tight but achievable for a pilot if Fieldstone is comfortable with a month-to-month pilot with a soft commit. If you do prefer a short reserved slot for >75k we can offer a 10% committed discount on the effective rate.

Procurement specifics: PO processing time averages:
- Standard PO (<$25k): same-week turnaround (no onboarding hold)
- Mid-tier ($25k–$75k): 2–3 weeks (legal review + billing set-up)
- Large (>$75k): 3–5 weeks (contract addendum + reserved capacity config)

If procurement wants a fixed calendar for onboarding windows I can propose dates next week.

-Jordan
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@fieldstonehealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@fieldstonehealth.com, aisha.rao@fieldstonehealth.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up after demo — spend band and PO thresholds

Thanks — numbers look reasonable. Two clarifying questions before we loop in legal: 1) in your worksheet, are the "cache" savings baked into the per-1M token rates shown, or listed separately? 2) can you confirm whether our existing data residency requirement (US-East) will add any surcharge if a reserved pool is requested?

Also, procurement asked if you can provide a single-line summary for our CFO that shows expected monthly burn for Low/Mid/High scenarios (include expected invoice cadence and any minimums). If you can get that to us by EOD Tuesday, that'll keep the calendar moving.

Regards,
Raj
Dir. of Data Platform, Fieldstone Health

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@fieldstonehealth.com>, aisha.rao@fieldstonehealth.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up after demo — spend band and PO thresholds

Raj — quick answers inline and attached a 1-slide summary for your CFO.

1) Cache savings: yes, the per-1M rates in the workbook are net of conservative cache assumptions (we included a separate row showing raw rates before cache for transparency). See worksheet tab "rates_net_vs_gross."

2) Data residency surcharge: for US-East-only reserved pools there is no surcharge for pilot reserved slots. For full private deployment (VPC/on-prem) there can be infra and support fees; we flagged that in the MAP but it's not applicable to the pilot pricing above.

Summary for CFO (attached):
- Low (1M tokens/mo): ~$1,600/month — monthly invoice, payable Net30, no PO required for pilot.
- Mid (3M tokens/mo): ~$3,450/month — monthly invoice, recommend PO; onboarding 2–3 weeks.
- High (5M tokens/mo): ~$4,600/month — monthly invoice, PO required; recommend reserved slot (3–5 week lead).

Attachments: MMP-token-econ-worksheet.csv, one-page CFO-summary (in Drive link).

If that works, Jordan will propose onboarding windows and I can prepare the PO template to speed legal review.

Cheers,
Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
